standard.description: Balanced — correctness + business + UX + browser runtime health (3 QD9 core probes) + cross-module integration (3 QD10 static probes)

deep.description: Thorough — thêm data integrity + security + full browser runtime (7 QD9 probes) + integration runtime (5 QD10 probes) + business completeness (2 QD11 LLM probes)

exhaustive.description: Full coverage — tất cả 11 dimensions (kèm QD8 Observability, QD9 Runtime Health, QD10 Cross-Module Integration, QD11 Business Completeness)

dimension_overrides.--only: Replace profile dimensions với user-specified list

safety_floor.rule: Profile >= standard KHONG được bỏ toàn bộ QD1+QD2+QD5

QD9.rule: Nen chay QD9 khi interface_type != api-only va khong --no-browser
QD9.applies_when: interface_type IN {web, mobile} VA --no-browser KHONG set

QD10.rule: Nen chay QD10 khi registry co cross_module_dependencies[] non-empty
QD10.applies_when: cross_module_dependencies[] co it nhat 1 entry VA profile != quick

QD11.rule: Nen chay QD11 khi >=2 modules VA interface_type != api-only VA profile != quick
QD11.applies_when: >=2 modules VA interface_type != api-only VA profile >= standard
